title: Ecoa Network — event envelope
$comment: The envelope is a CLOSED set: additionalProperties is false on purpose. A node that dropped an unknown field would compute a different digest than one that kept it, and the two would disagree about whether a valid event is valid. See docs/protocol.md.

protocol.$comment: Names the network, not just the protocol. `ecoa` is the main network; anything else is `ecoa-<name>`. Inside the signed bytes, so a test-network event is never valid in production.

author.$comment: The identity. Every "same author" comparison in the protocol is against this field, never against the key that signed.

deviceKey.$comment: Required but nullable, never omitted: under JCS a null-valued key and an absent key hash differently.

eventType.$comment: namespace.verb, with digits allowed after the dot, as in review.created_v2. An unrecognized value is structurally valid and still relayed; it just skips the type-specific checks.
